description.value: Tama Organic Life Foods is a small, family-run organic produce store that has been serving the Vancouver community since 1995–1996, specializing in locally grown Japanese specialty vegetables such as daikon, burdock root, and komatsuna sourced directly from BC farms. The store carries a wide range of seasonal organic fruits, vegetables, dried goods, and Japanese pantry staples, and also prepares daily vegan bento boxes made to order using all organic ingredients. Its long-standing direct relationships with organic farmers across BC — from the Fraser Valley to Vancouver Island and the Okanagan — make it a distinctive stop for cyclists seeking high-quality local produce.
